name: bookstats
description: Personal library tracking and visual reading statistics for web, Windows, and macOS.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c auto "npm run dev -w @bookstats/client" "npm run dev -w @bookstats/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bookstats/domain && npm run build -w @bookstats/statistics && npm run build -w @bookstats/client && npm run build -w @bookstats/admin && npm run build -w @bookstats/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bookstats/domain && npm run typecheck -w @bookstats/statistics && npm run typecheck -w @bookstats/client && npm run typecheck -w @bookstats/admin && npm run typecheck -w @bookstats/server
scripts.tauri:dev: concurrently -k -s first -n api,desktop -c auto "npm run dev:server" "npm run tauri:dev -w @bookstats/client"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
